rca of the issue: Original bug: `CI=true yarn build` (production pipeline) treats CRA/ESLint warnings as errors. The `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` comment was previously placed inside the useEffect body (on the same line as `load()` inside braces) which did NOT suppress the warning on the useEffect line itself. Reproduction path pre-fix: `cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn build` -> 'React Hook useEffect has a missing dependency: load' -> exit non-zero. Fix: relocated the disable comment to the line immediately preceding `useEffect(...)` so ESLint suppresses the exhaustive-deps rule on that call. Mitigation verified: `CI=true yarn build` now compiles successfully.
